versions.content: function  Com_MainFunctionTx  [SWS_CP_COM_00008]   void Com_MainFunctionTx(void); Cyclic task executing periodic transmission of cyclic I-PDUs and decrementing transmission timers. PDU Router (PduR) The PDU Router routes I-PDUs between communication interfaces (CAN, LIN, FlexRay, Ethernet) and upper layer modules (COM, DCM, SecOC).
